outputs.explanation: Panel A consists only of micrograph images (GFP, DsRed, MitoTracker, Merge); no plot of averaged data is present.
The bar charts (JC-1 relative intensity and anti-HMGB1 intensity, n=20) show only mean bars with error bars; no individual data points are overlaid.
Panel C is a western blot image, not a plot of averaged data.
The SDH and COX signal-intensity bar charts show group means with error bars and sample sizes (N) noted in the bars, but no individual data points are plotted.

The FACS histograms display full population distributions of TMRM intensity for each sample, which inherently show the underlying data rather than a single averaged summary statistic; the schematic portions of the panel are not plots requiring individual points.
